headline: Customs projects collecting over RD$270,000 million; AIRD highlights its role in competitiveness
summary: The Dominican Republic's customs agency collected RD$152,303 million between January and July. The American Institute of Dominican Republic (AIRD) called for continued modernization of controls and trade facilitation.
why: Customs revenue reflects trade volumes and tax collection, which are key indicators of the Dominican economy's health.
